data.name: Kana
data.long_meaning: The name Kana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kinnari', which refers to a celestial being or 'Apsara' in Hindu mythology. The Kinnari is a beautiful and graceful creature, often depicted as a bird with the lower body of a woman. Kana signifies the inner beauty and grace that a woman embodies. It is a name that signifies motherhood, nurturing, and the ability to create and sustain life.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kana is a name that holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the name invokes the blessings of the divine mother, Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, arts, wisdom, and learning. Kana is a name that represents the feminine divine and the power of creation and nurturing.

Despite his loyalty, Karna ultimately fought on the side of righteousness and was killed by Arjuna, one of the Pandava brothers.
